apps.label: Rusty XR Mic Pipe Sentinel
apps.description: Visible user-started microphone foreground-service sentinel that streams 16 kHz mono PCM16 to a localhost Termux receiver. Build it locally; APK bytes are ignored and not committed.

deviceProfiles.label: Mic pipe smoke test
deviceProfiles.description: Short Quest verification profile for a visible microphone session and localhost PCM transport.

runtimeProfiles.label: Mic pipe to localhost Termux
runtimeProfiles.description: Launches the visible panel for a user-started microphone session. Start the Termux receiver before pressing Start in the panel.
